ana_cs: Heads up — Vanguard (hosted) weekly health check. Commit $50k/mo. Last 7d spend okay but billing-bot flagged a big 24h spike. Details below.

billing-bot: [Alert] Hosted spend anomaly for account=vanguard. 24h spend=$9,120 (+3.7x baseline). Estimated daily baseline=$1,600. Flag=MED. https://billing.internal/alerts/VA-908

arun_cs: Copy. Any obvious root cause? New SDKs or integration changes on their side?

jess_onboard: They finished onboarding 2w ago. No SDK rollouts from us. Notes: they enabled longer responses via response_length param last Wed.

mike_revops: Pulled logs quickly — top routes: /v1/generate/chat (78%), /v1/embed (12%). Top model: gptx-8k-quant. Avg tokens/request jumped from ~1.2k -> ~7.8k. Calls concentrated in 00:00–06:00 UTC.

ana_cs_typo_check: (ignore)

ana_cs: (typo above) Oops. Reposting: Looks like prompt/profile change. Could be a misconfigured batching/test harness. Anyone see a load test?

jess_onboard: Reached their eng lead (dpatel). They confirmed experimenting with multi-document prompts for reranking — likely concatenating many docs into one call.

mike_revops: Quick query I ran: 
``
SELECT route, avg(tokens) FROM logs WHERE account='vanguard' AND ts > now()-1d GROUP BY route ORDER BY avg(tokens) DESC LIMIT 5;
``
Result: chat avg_tokens=7800, calls=118.

arun_cs: Proposed mitigations: 1) temporary per-route soft rate cap (50% of normal) 2) enable prefix/KV caching on chat model 3) ask client to rollback or shorten prompts.

ana_cs_second_typo: (ignore)

ana_cs: @eng-oncall can we add a soft limit on /v1/generate/chat for account=vanguard? Want to avoid hitting commit overage alarms and protect tail latency.

ops_alerts: eng-oncall notified: INC-2026-819 created, assigned to nina_oncall. Triage ETA ~30m.

nina_oncall: Taking it now. I'll add a temporary rate-limit and enable monitoring for token/sec and 95th latency. Will update in thread.

billing-bot: [Update] After soft rate cap applied, 4h projection reduces to ~$2.1k/day. If sustained, commit breach avoided.

ana_cs: Client updated: they paused the new reranking pipeline. They asked for our telemetry export for troubleshooting. Jess — can you send a short best-practices note about safe prompt sizing and server-side throttles?

jess_onboard: Will do. I'll prepare a 1-pager + example config (rate-limit + caching) and send to their SREs. Also marking renewal risk: currently LOW but bump to MED if we see two more spikes in the next 30d.

ana_cs: :thumbsup: Good work. Closing loop for today — we'll reconvene in tomorrow's weekly health sync and add notes to the account. Filing this thread in the account record.
